name: Luxury Typography Web
summary: Large, high-contrast serif type on a calm ground, wide tracking on small caps, thin rules and few words. The letter is the main image, and space signals price and care.

philosophy.core_thesis: Luxury is restraint and craft: fine type, wide space and few words.
design_principles: Set the hero in a high-contrast serif at 72px to 160px, weight 300 to 400, with tracking of -0.02em.
Set labels and menu in upper case at 11px to 12px with tracking of +0.2em to +0.3em.
Use a ground of ivory (#F6F1E8) or deep black (#0E0D0C) and text in the opposite tone; add one metal accent (#A8863B) for rules and small marks.
Use hairlines of 1px in the accent; use no box, no shadow and no radius above 0px.
Show one product or one image per screen at large size with 120px or more of space around it.
Write short copy of 12 words or fewer per block and avoid sale words and prices in the hero.
Animate slowly: fades and 16px lifts in 700ms to 1100ms.
anti_patterns: Dense product grids with small images

layout.grid_mechanics: A wide, centred layout with a 12-column grid; large type spans 8 to 12 columns; products sit in 2 to 3 columns with generous gaps.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 55% to 70% of the surface is empty; vertical gaps are 120px to 240px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero and centred captions; menus flush with a wide letter space; small text flush left.
layout.container_geometry: Square corners; hairline frames; images with no radius.

font_pairings.note: A sharp didone for the headline with a clean sans for labels.
A fine, light serif with a thin geometric sans.
A strong didone with high contrast for fashion titles.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 300 to 400 for display and 400 for body.
Set labels in upper case at 11px to 12px.
Set italics in the serif for names and accents.

color.palette_structure: Ivory or black with one metal accent.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on ivory holds 16:1; brass at #836320 holds 4.5:1 on ivory for small marks; on black use #C9A24D.
color.surface_treatment: Flat ivory or black with no texture; a faint grain at 3% is optional.
color.light_and_shadow: No shadow; a 1px brass rule marks edges.

materiality.surface_simulation: Fine paper, brass foil and printed type.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px brass or taupe hairline; no thick line.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin 1px outline icons or none; small brass stars and monograms.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Editorial photography of one object, a model or a detail, with generous crop and space.

motion.transition_physics: Slow and calm: fades and 16px lifts; images reveal with a 900ms mask; no bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover draws a brass underline in 400ms and lifts the image 4px in 600ms; active state dims by 6%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels that this is rare, careful and expensive.

avoid_when: The brand sells on price or volume.
The page needs a dense catalogue or a fast checkout.
The audience reads on small screens in poor light and needs large text.

modifiers.how: Replace the didone by a neutral sans; keep the space and the single accent.
Add gold geometry and a deep green or black ground.
Add a magazine grid and larger photographs.

pack.why: A thin outline family that matches hairline rules and fine serifs.

ground.why: Luxury print sits inside a hairline frame on heavy cream stock.
